title: Give to the Winds Your Fears

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Give to the winds your fears;
God hears your sighs and coundts your tears,
God shall lift up your head.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Your ways put in His hands
To His sure truth adn tender care

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: O put your trust in God;
Walk in His strength with faith and hope,
So shall your work be done.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: So you shall, faithful, seek His way
how wise, how strong His hand!
